nodes.title: Leftmost derivations in the ambiguity grammar

nodes.summary: Let $P = [(t_0, b_0), \dots, (t_{m-1}, b_{m-1})]$ be a list of dominoes, and let $A$, $B$ be the nonterminals of the ambiguity grammar of $P$ for its top and bottom words. Every production of that grammar with left-hand side $A$ is $A \to t_i\, A\, i$ or $A \to t_i\, i$ for some $i < m$, and every production with left-hand side $B$ is $B \to b_i\, B\, i$ or $B \to b_i\, i$ for some $i < m$.

nodes.title: Leftmost derivations from the start symbol along an index sequence

nodes.summary: For every alphabet $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding by natural numbers and decidable equality, the Post correspondence problem over $\alpha$ many-one reduces to ambiguity of encoded context-free grammars over the terminals $\alpha \sqcup \mathbb{N}$: there is a computable function sending each list $P$ of dominoes over $\alpha$ to such a grammar, which is ambiguous if and only if $P$ has a PCP solution.
nodes.title: PCP many-one reduces to ambiguity of context-free grammars

nodes.summary: For every alphabet $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding by natural numbers, the map sending a list $P$ of dominoes over $\alpha$ to the ambiguity grammar of $P$ is primitive recursive, where encoded grammars are encoded as pairs of a start nonterminal and a list of productions.
nodes.title: The ambiguity grammar is primitive recursive

nodes.title: The start production $S \to A$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
